traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text:
The carrion claw can climb difficult surfaces, including
upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Magical Light Sensitivity
traits.text:
While in magical light, the carrion claw has
disadvantage on attack rolls, and opponents have advantage on attack rolls
against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The carrion claw makes one bite attack and three claw
attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11
(2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than undead, it
must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for
1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its
turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17
(3d8 +4) slashing damage.
